description: A React component page for health checking the backend API at /health/. It displays the current health status, last checked time, and provides a button to re-trigger the health check.

methods.name: HealthcheckPage
methods.description: React functional component that manages health check status and last checked time, rendering UI elements including a button to re-check the backend health.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Asynchronous function that calls the API endpoint /health/ to retrieve the backend health status and updates the component state accordingly.
